decisions.statement: A change arriving while a run of the same file is in progress is dropped.
A change arriving before the debounce has elapsed is dropped.
The debounce is measured from when the last run began rather than from when that run ended.
The clock the debounce reads is handed in.
The run is handed to a queue rather than awaited here.
A file that never settles is reported as skipped.
A file absent from disk is reported as not found.
Content matching the last write-back is dropped rather than dispatched.
Content closing with no brace is reported as a parse failure.
A write-back is refused where the file changed after the stable read.
The dispatch this handler calls is handed in rather than imported.
Which side file a kind of file has is read off the operation targets rather than branched on here.
A side file config path key is derived from that side file's name.
A side file hash the dispatch answers is remembered against the file.
A throw inside the run is logged rather than raised.
A run that ends leaves the file marked as no longer running.
No module yet hands this handler a dispatch.
Nothing here names the account a run outcome is reported under.
Nothing here parses the content a saved-variables file has.

definition: one change to a watched file turned into one dispatch of that file's content
